    if noun.endswith(("s", "sh", "ch", "x", "z")):
        return noun + "es"

        attr_pl = _pluralize(attr)

        corrupt = f"The {subj_pl} {prep} the {attr}"

            "corrupt": corrupt,
            "answers": [" is"],
            "wrong_answers": [" are"],
